context: Re-run the exact pinned conformance and Inspector artifacts, inspect the scenario source and BenchBox capability/tool inventory, and write a revision-bound rationale for each of the four entries. For missing-capability checks, either prove the diagnostic fixture is not part of the BenchBox production contract and keep a narrowly scoped baseline, or implement the protocol-required rejection and remove the exceptions. For list-change warnings, either prove registries are immutable and add an invariant/regression guard, or implement the required notifications if dynamic mutations are supported. Update the verifier and readiness documentation only after the evidence supports the change; any new failure outside the exact baseline must fail the gate.
description: The pinned MCP 2026-07-28 conformance run at revision 81eb1c3 passes the selected scenarios only with four explicit server-stateless baseline entries: two required checks for the diagnostic test_missing_capability fixture and two SHOULD warnings for promptsListChanged and toolsListChanged notifications. The run log classifies the first pair as a fixture/tool-surface gap and the second pair as a static-registry behavior, but this compatibility debt is not yet independently tracked. Revalidate the classification against the current upstream suite and BenchBox contract; do not let the baseline hide a real protocol defect or silently broaden it when upstream checks change.

The production endpoint remains fail-closed while the classification or evidence is stale
